class gen_shared_file.setup.dep_validator.GenSharedFileBundleDependenciesValidator[source]¶

Bases: object

Validator for the gen_shared_file bundle dependencies.

It defines:

methods:
validate - Validates the gen_shared_file bundle dependencies.
is_valid - Checks if the gen_shared_file bundle dependencies is valid.
classmethod is_valid(gensharedfilebundledependencies: GenSharedFileBundleDependencies) → bool[source]¶

Checks if the gensharedfilebundledependencies is valid.

Parameters:

gensharedfilebundledependencies – The gensharedfilebundledependencies to be checked.

Returns:

True if valid, False otherwise.

classmethod validate(dependencies: GenSharedFileBundleDependencies) → None[source]¶

Validates the gen_shared_file bundle dependencies.

Parameters:

dependencies – The gen_shared_file bundle dependencies to be validated.

Exceptions:
ATSValueError: The gen_shared_file bundle dependencies must be provided and have proper values.
ATSTypeError: The gen_shared_file bundle dependencies must be an instance of Mapping and its
attributes must be instances of their respective types.
